_purpose: E2 (OOD bpb) + E3 (unseen-language bpb), campaign E1-E5

segmentation.rule: split on newline into paragraphs; oversized paragraphs split at the last space before max_chars (character boundary if no space). No tokenizer truncation -- scored bytes == counted bytes.

e2_ood.sampling_rule: equal BYTES per language; whole documents only (never truncated); documents that would exceed the budget are skipped, not cut; body text field only (no title/summary); fixed shuffle seed
